header: What trade press wrote about the night network

mentions.quote: This carrier publishes its on-time rate to one decimal place, and it held 98.4 % through the November peak.
Bonded loads out of Eindhoven now clear customs in 41 minutes on average, and the paperwork never leaves the depot.
Nightly chilled departures from Oslo let three grocery chains give up their own city fleets without missing a store opening.
